2609.35426.title: Frontier Learning: Training LLM Reasoners at the Edge of Capability
2609.35426.paper_summary: Reinforcement Learning-based post-training of Large Language Models (LLM) has been successfully applied to improve their reasoning capabilities. Existing pipelines primarily finetune LLMs on a fixed pool of problems specified prior to training using the GRPO loss. This is fundamentally limiting, as learning signal arises only when policy rollouts mix successes and failures, causing the useful portion of any fixed pool to quickly become stale as the model improves. To address this, we propose frontier learning, an open-ended post-training approach in which procedural generators are used online to continually produce informative training problems. It treats the generator's task-specific parameters as a search space and uses a regret signal to prioritize and explore frontier difficulty levels in order to focus training at the edge of the model's evolving reasoning capabilities. Across several reasoning tasks and model families, our approach consistently achieves higher relative gains over fixed-pool baselines, demonstrating that effective post-training requires not only selecting useful problems, but continually generating them at the edge of capability.
2609.35426.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習基礎的大型語言模型（LLM）後訓練已成功應用於提高其推理能力。現有的流程主要是在訓練之前指定的固定問題池上微調LLM，使用GRPO損失。這在根本上是有限制的，因為學習信號僅在策略展開混合成功與失敗時產生，導致任何固定池的有用部分隨著模型的改進迅速變得過時。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了前沿學習，這是一種開放式的後訓練方法，其中使用程序生成器在線持續產生有信息的訓練問題。它將生成器的任務特定參數視為搜索空間，並使用懊悔信號來優先考慮和探索前沿難度水平，以便將訓練集中在模型不斷演變的推理能力的邊緣。在幾個推理任務和模型系列中，我們的方法始終在固定池基準上實現更高的相對增益，證明有效的後訓練不僅需要選擇有用的問題，還需要在能力邊緣持續生成它們。
